payload.description_html: Original, raw and rarest photos of the beaches and world famous “Tinapang Salinas” (dried fish industry - Tamban, Sardinella and Herring) of Rosario, formerly Salinas, Cavite is the place where smoked fish called “Tinapang Salinas” originates.[1] Rosario, Cavite’s world renowned “Tinapang Salinas” (smoked salinas fish); “Tinapa Festival” is held every month of October. The Town of Rosario’s being the foremost producer of agricultural products specifically smoked fish in the Philippines is named as the Smoked Fish Capital of Cavite.[2] Capt. Joaquin Soriano St., Ligtong IV, Rosario (formerly Salinas) 4106[3]original name: Ligtong Geographical location: Cavite, Region 4, Philippines, Asia Geographical coordinates: 14° 25' 38" North, 120° 52' 15" East This place is situated in Cavite, Region 4, Philippines, its geographical coordinates are 14° 25' 38" North, 120° 52' 15" East and its original name (with diacritics) is Ligtong. Where to Buy Tinapang Salinas, A Product from Rosario, Cavite -- Carm Food Enterprise, Talleres de Nazaret and MCP Tinapang Salinas.Rosario, Cavite[4] Coordinates: 14°24'48"N 120°51'44"E [5] [6] Tinapang Salinas (C.F.E., 257 Don Basillio Leyva Street, Ligtong 4, Rosario, Cavite)[7]--Tamban or Sardinella [8][9] is a genus of fishes in the family Clupeidae.[10] This genus currently contains 21 recognized species. herring n. a species of fish: tamban, silinyasi, tunsoy] and Herring [11] are forage fish, mostly belonging to the family Clupeidae, Clupea harengus.-------[N.B. May 25, 2013, Saturday, Philippines Photography of Noveleta, Cavite and Rosario, Cavite[12]: 30% cloudy and 70% sunny weather using my Nikon AW 100 waterproof shockproof camera. From Bulacan at 9:35 a.m., I took photo of the Baliuag Transit Original station, and at 11:38 a.m., the 5th Avenue LRT Station[13]; then I arrived at Rosario, Cavite and captured Noveleta Battle bridge at 2:08 pm, and then the Salinas Town or Rosario, Cavite at 2:33 pm and finished photography at 7:04 pm, and arrived at Bulacan at 11:30 pm after 4+ hours of travel by bus, and started uploading via slow internet at 11:40 pm - I hereby certify that these raw, original and unedited photos are exclusive for Commons and Wikipedia never uploaded in any Internet or any site, and for the public domain without any condition.]
